label: The Legendre symbol: Euler's criterion, multiplicativity and Gauss's lemma
excerpt: Let p be an odd prime. (Theorem 2.20) Exactly half the elements of Z_p^* are squares. (Theorem 12.1(i)-(iii)) Consequently (a|p) == a^{(p-1)/2} (mod p), so (-1|p) = (-1)^{(p-1)/2}; the symbol is multiplicative, (a|p)(b|p) = (ab|p); and it depends only on a mod p.
